title: Resource Manifest
description: Fixed schema for verification/<task>/resource-manifest.json. Referenced from a Task's '## Resource Manifest' section via a single repository-relative path. Every source_path / destination_path is preserved verbatim; normalised forms live only in derived fields produced by the checker, never written back here.

schema_version.description: Only version 1 is accepted. A future version requires a new checker release.

task_id.description: Must equal the id of the Task whose section references this file.

resource_type.description: Free-form category, e.g. worktree, generated-build-artifacts, evidence.

source_path.description: Original expression exactly as recorded. Brace shorthand, %VARS% and globs may appear here and are NEVER expanded.

disposition.description: ALREADY_ABSENT is the only value permitted for a resource that was listed but whose target no longer exists. NOT_APPLICABLE means the resource never applied and must never be used for a vanished target.

destination_path.description: Original expression exactly as recorded. May hold prose such as 'Same source location'; the checker resolves it only when it is a plain resolvable path.

manifest_path.description: Repository-relative path to a manifest file, when integrity is carried by a file rather than an inline hash.

process_check.description: Reference / running-process check and its result. Required even for ALREADY_ABSENT, where it must state that no reference remains.

absent_evidence.description: ALREADY_ABSENT only: how it was established that the target no longer exists.

closeout_counts.description: Every key must be a non-negative integer. The checker cross-checks these against the resources array: each record whose boolean of the same name is true contributes one to that count.
